<issue>
ParagraphFormat.space_after returns None when pPr element exists

#### Description

When accessing the `space_after` property on a `ParagraphFormat` object, it incorrectly returns `None` even when the paragraph properties element (`pPr`) exists and contains spacing information.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt

# Create a document and add a paragraph
doc = Document()
paragraph = doc.add_paragraph("Test paragraph")

# Set space after the paragraph
paragraph.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(12)

# Try to read the space_after value back
space_after = paragraph.paragraph_format.space_after
print(f"Expected: 12pt spacing, Got: {space_after}")
```

The above code should return the spacing value that was set, but instead returns `None`.
</issue>
